Anonymizing data in reports (RES-04) protects student identities. Timely notifications of attendance status (RES-05) keep students informed, which is a social responsibility. These requirements collectively ensure ethical and compliant operations of the system.

Real-time data synchronization (SAF-02) ensures accuracy across all classes, while automated alerts for discrepancies (SAF-03) promote data integrity. transcript.statement: The security and privacy of student attendance data are essential for maintaining trust in the RollCall system. Data encryption (TRU-01) protects sensitive information from unauthorized access, while role-based access control (TRU-02) ensures that only authorized users can access specific data. Maintaining an audit log (TRU-03) is crucial for accountability and traceability of data changes. Students must authenticate before viewing their records (TRU-04) to safeguard their privacy. Implementing integrity checks (TRU-05) ensures that attendance data remains accurate, while a reporting mechanism for breaches (TRU-06) empowers users to alert any unauthorized access. Session timeouts (TRU-07) further enhance security by logging out inactive users, reducing the risk of data breaches.

Optimizing storage for historical data (EFF-04) balances performance and resource consumption. transcript.statement: Sustainability is crucial for the RollCall system. requirements.text: The system shall comply with data protection regulations and allow students to dispute attendance records.
The system shall maintain historical attendance data for a minimum of five years, ensuring compliance and efficiency.
The system shall implement role-based access control and log manual overrides with user details to ensure accountability.
The system shall use energy-efficient algorithms in security measures to minimize energy consumption while ensuring safety.
The system shall provide real-time updates for attendance while ensuring low energy consumption.
The system shall ensure data integrity by implementing encryption and checksums for attendance data.
The system shall generate attendance reports efficiently while ensuring user privacy through anonymization.
